content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00213, SRS_BSW_00347 <return> SchM_Mode_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<name>( OUT <previousmode>, OUT <nextmode>) ) Where here <bsnp> is the BSW Scheduler Name Prefix according [SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594], <vi> is the vendorId of the calling BSW module, <ai> vendorApiInfix of the calling BSW module and <name> is the ( requiredModeGroup or providedModeGroup ) ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype name. The sub part in squared brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module . See [SWS_Rte_07528].
